question: Q2 compound -> sensory-dimension Top-3 direction stability

definition.pointDirection: sign of the point-estimate total Spearman (200 SPLIT-0001 train rows) for the same (compound, dimension) cell
definition.zeroToleranceRule: a replicate with |rho| <= 1e-12 is counted as `zero` (near-zero), never as positive and never as negative
definition.invalid: rho is not finite (NaN/inf) and therefore has no direction
definition.p_positive_legacy: superseded rule (rho > 0) / bootstrapReps, kept as a control column
definition.undetermined: a zero or non-computable point estimate is labelled `direction-undetermined`; it is never folded into the negative direction and 1 - p_positive is never reported as a negative frequency
definition.notClaimed: this is the stability of the total-correlation DIRECTION; it is not the stability of the low-rank coefficients, not a causal direction and not an accuracy measure
